user.title: Helios Forecast: panel line
user.description: One forecast for a photovoltaic installation. Add a panel line per orientation, several lines share this installation's single production sensor and inverter cap. Leave the location blank to use your Home Assistant home.

data.name: Name (e.g. South roof)
data.azimuth: Azimuth (degrees from north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west)
data.line_inverter_max_kw: Inverter max output for this line (kW, optional)
data.production_entity: PV production energy sensor (kWh, for the learned correction)
data.battery_min_soc: Battery reserve, minimum state of charge (%, default 10)
data.curtailment_entity: Curtailment signal (binary sensor, input boolean or switch, optional)

data_description.production_entity: A cumulative energy sensor (kWh), e.g. your inverter's or energy meter's total production. A power sensor (W) will not work: it has no long-term sum statistics, so the learning and the reliability index would stay off.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Fill in the capacity and this sensor to turn on the battery state-of-charge projection. Home consumption is taken from your Energy dashboard, so it needs no sensor here.
data_description.curtailment_entity: On while your inverter is being held back for a reason the sky cannot explain: a full battery, a zero-export rule, a grid limit. The hours it marks are not learned as low production. Without it, a full battery is still detected from the state of charge sensor and the inverter cap.

benchmark.title: Helios Forecast: community benchmark
benchmark.description:
An open measurement of how accurate Helios Forecast really is, on real installations, published as it goes. Would you like to take part? It happens here: [helios-ha.org/benchmark](https://helios-ha.org/benchmark)

Get a key in one click, with no account and no name, then paste it below. To stop everything, clear it.

data.benchmark_enabled: Contribute to the public accuracy benchmark (optional)

data_description.benchmark_enabled: Sends what this installation predicts, once an hour, so it can be compared with what it really produced. The results are published openly. Only your panel geometry, the predicted curve, the measured production and the reliability index are sent: no entity names, no consumption, no other sensor, and your coordinates rounded to about a kilometre. Off unless you turn it on.
data_description.benchmark_key: The write key you were given when joining the benchmark. Nothing is sent without it.
data_description.benchmark_url: Leave this as it is unless you run your own collector.

get_forecast.name: Get forecast
get_forecast.description: Returns the full production forecast (today onward, one point per 15 minutes, each with the predicted watts and the P10/P90 confidence band) as response data, for use in automations.

config_entry_id.name: Installation
config_entry_id.description: Which Helios Forecast installation to read. Optional when only one is configured.

get_battery_soc_forecast.name: Get battery SoC forecast
get_battery_soc_forecast.description: Returns the projected battery state of charge for the next 48 hours (one point per 15 minutes) as response data, for use in automations.
